wallet_fill_floors.note: every rung listed here carries its own surface, B1 bound check, deploy point and two placebos under by_measure.<measure>.by_K; the blocks at the top of each measure are the headline rung repeated, so a figure read there is a figure at K50. override_reasons.rank_floor_fills: the headline cell gates takers at 50 early fills, which IS the declared 50: a CONFIRMATION and not a deviation. It was 10 until 2026-07-31. _meta.object: B2 fill-aware net economics of the counterparty-toxicity skew
_meta.author: Dmitry Stakhin
_meta.split_rule: The label and evaluation halves are DERIVED from the days present, by settings.split_early_late through maker_econ.early_late_days: first ceil(n/2) days early, the rest late. maker_econ.py used to declare them as the day-of-month tuples (4,5,6,7,8) and (9,10,11,12,13), correct only for a window opening on the 4th and closing on the 13th. This input does open on the 4th, so the derived split reproduces those tuples exactly and no number moved.
_meta.framing: COST REDUCTION, NEVER NET ALPHA; B2 <= B1 upper bound; symmetric maker net-negative at every tier (maker_econ).
_meta.policy: benign accepted as-is; toxic recaptured fraction f at +w bps minus penalty c, declined (1-f). f=0 is B1 decline-entirely.
_meta.declined_flow_split: SIGN REPAIRED 2026-08-03. Every accounting block splits the declined toxic-wallet notional into the part the maker was EARNING on (benign_notional_declined_usd, pre-fee net m > 0) and the part it was LOSING on (adverse_notional_declined_usd, m <= 0). Until this date the field benign_notional_declined_usd was built from the predicate m <= 0 and therefore held the adverse half under the benign name, so benign_share_of_declined published 0.7031 on net_MID_lower and 0.6720 on net_PRINT where the benign shares are 0.2969 and 0.3280. The consequence is a reversed reading and not a shifted number: the screen declines flow that was predominantly costing the maker, where the old field said it was predominantly harmless. Any figure taken from benign_share_of_declined in an artifact written before 2026-08-03 is the complement of what its name says.
_meta.label_horizon_policy: LABELS AND MEASUREMENT SHARE ONE HORIZON. Takers were RANKED on the early-window mean a_mid at horizon_s seconds AND the late-window P&L was MEASURED at horizon_s seconds. Nothing here mixes a ranking horizon with a different measurement horizon, and eligibility (at least K early fills with a finite a_mid) is counted at that same horizon. The B1 upper bound this surface is read against is the maker_econ block at the MATCHING horizon key, so compare b2 horizon_s against maker_econ b1_idealized_policy_upper_bound h<horizon_s> and never against a different one.
_meta.floor_key_policy: EVERY RUNG OF THE LADDER IS PUBLISHED, keyed K<fills> under by_measure.<measure>.by_K, which is the spelling maker_econ.py and mm_bakeoff.py already use for the same floor. The five blocks at the top of by_measure.<measure> are the k_headline rung repeated, so a reader on the old path still lands on a number and _meta says which rung it is. Before 2026-07-31 this file wrote the headline rung and nothing else, so raising the headline would have deleted the ten-fill arm instead of adding a fifty-fill one. Placebo streams: the headline rung draws from this file's seed stream in its historical order, every other rung from default_rng([SEED, K]), so no rung's null depends on what else the ladder holds.
